methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper provides both researchers and policymakers with a practical approach to monitor and benchmark the energy performance of dwellings owned by organisations.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus on residential dwellings/building stocks without an industrial component.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A total of 246 housing associations participated with over 2 million dwellings, covering 95% of the Dutch non-profit housing sector.

stage1.notes: Residential housing-only study; excluded by the Stage-1 domain rule despite presenting a benchmark model.
